LAW AND MOTION 301, BEFORE THE ARGUMENT, JUDGE BUSCH MADE A DISCLOSURE ABOUT HIS WIFE, CATHARINE BARNES, A DEPUTY CITY ATTORNEY NOT INVOLVED IN THIS CASE AND THAT HE DOES NOT VIEW HER EMPLOYMENT AS A BASIS FOR RECUSAL. NO OBJECTIONS WERE MADE. THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. AFTER THE ARGUMENT, DEFENDANT THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND FOR PLAINTIFF TO PLEAD A BASIS ON WHICH ITS OTHERWISE UNTIMELY CLAIM TO THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY SHOULD BE OTHERWISE BE DEEMED TO SATISFY THE PLAINTIFF'S REQUIREMENT TO MAKE A CLAIM. THE COURT ORDERED MR. HOWARD TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN CSR # 8189 (301/PJB)
